summary.tldr: Requires the federal agriculture minister to develop a national strategy on soil health and report on it to Parliament.
what_it_does: Requires the Minister of Agriculture and Agri-Food to develop a national strategy to protect, conserve and enhance soil health across Canada, with help from other federal ministers.

Requires provinces, Indigenous governing bodies and municipalities to have a chance to help develop the strategy, and requires public consultation with stakeholders, agricultural groups and other interested persons.
Requires the strategy to set out policy and legislative measures to recognise soil as a national asset and to support sustainable and profitable production of food, fibre and fuel.
Requires the strategy to include measures for soil research, data collection, monitoring, education, training, knowledge sharing and a national soil information system.
Requires the strategy to include recommendations on a National Advocate for Soil Health, plus targets, timelines and the resources needed.
Requires the minister to table the strategy in Parliament within two years, then table progress reports every three years and publish them online.
summary.background: The bill defines “Minister” as the Minister of Agriculture and Agri-Food. It also defines “Indigenous governing body” for the purposes of the Act.
